name: Creamy Tuna Pasta with Tomatoes, Zucchini, Basil & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1 cup of cooking water before draining; set aside.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g rotini pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons; place in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the zucchini.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and place in the reserved bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add half of the basil to the bowl with the tomatoes. (Set remaining basil aside for garnish.)
Add tomato paste to the pot with the veggies; cook, stirring often, for 1 minute.

Drain tuna and flake with a fork; add to the pot along with cream, salt, and pepper; stir to combine the sauce. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring often, until sauce thickens slightly, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water
355 ml heavy whipping cream
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is cooking, finely grate Parmesan.
Add drained pasta to the pot along with tomatoes and basil; stir to combine. Add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls; top with Parmesan and reserved basil. Enjoy!
